chapters.title: The great day of the Lord
chapters.summary: In King Josiah's days, Zephaniah warns that the day of the Lord is near, a day of wrath on Judah's idolatry and complacency.

chapters.title: Seek the Lord
chapters.summary: Seek the Lord, all you humble of the land; perhaps you will be hidden on the day of His anger. Judgment also comes on the surrounding nations.

chapters.title: He will rejoice over you
chapters.summary: After judgment, God will purify the peoples and leave a humble remnant. The Lord your God is in your midst; He will rejoice over you with singing.
